name: Unilateral Visa-Free Entry (trial policy)
summary: Ordinary passport holders from 50 listed countries can enter for up to 30 days without a visa. It is a trial that runs through Dec 31, 2026 for most countries, so check before you book.

other: Ordinary passport only.
Allowed purposes: business, tourism, visiting family or friends, exchange, transit, sports events, conferences and exhibitions, study tours.
No work, study or news reporting.
Valid until Dec 31, 2026 for all except Russia (Dec 31, 2027) and Brunei (no end date).
Czech Republic is not on the list.
US, India, Mexico and others are not on this list. See the 240-hour transit record.

sources.label: Chinese Embassy in Sweden: FAQs on Visa-free Entry (updated 2026-05-25)
Chinese Embassy in Croatia: Notice on extending unilateral visa-free policy
Ministry of Foreign Affairs: visa waiver for Canada and UK

stay.note: Counted from the day after entry. Multiple entries allowed, no cap on total days right now. Longer stays need a visa in advance, or a stay permit from the local exit-entry office.

steps: Check your country is on the list.
Fly or travel in with an ordinary passport valid for your stay.
Carry proof of purpose like a hotel booking and onward ticket.

name: 240-Hour Visa-Free Transit
summary: Citizens of 57 countries can enter visa-free for up to 10 days if they have a confirmed onward ticket to a third country or region. Work, study and news reporting are not allowed.

other: Ordinary passport only.
Must hold onward ticket with confirmed date and seat to a third country or region (not back to where you came from).
Stay limited to the designated area for that port.
Enter through any of 65 open ports in 24 provinces and regions.

sources.label: NIA: Kyrgyzstan and Vietnam added (57 countries, 65 ports)

name: 24-Hour Direct Transit (no visa)
summary: Anyone with a connecting ticket to a third country or region can pass through China without a visa for up to 24 hours if they stay in the port area. About 10 more airports were added in late 2025.

other: Applies to all nationalities per NIA.
Must not leave the port of entry.

sources.label: Chinese Embassy in Maldives: Visa Exemption

name: Mutual Visa Exemption Agreements
summary: China has mutual visa exemption agreements with 158 countries as of April 2025, but many cover only diplomatic or service passports. Some cover ordinary passports, with limits from 14 to 90 days.

other: Check the official list of agreements for your passport type and stay limit.

sources.label: NIA: List of mutual visa exemption agreements

name: Hainan 30-Day Visa-Free Entry
summary: Ordinary passport holders from 61 countries can enter Hainan without a visa and stay up to 30 days, within Hainan only. Allowed purposes include tourism, business, visits, medical care, conferences and sports.

other: Ordinary passport only.
Must enter through an open Hainan port.
No work or study.
Register with local police within 24 hours if not staying in a hotel.

name: Regional Group Tour Visa-Free Entry
summary: Tour groups can enter visa-free through set routes: Guangdong groups from Hong Kong or Macao (up to 6 days), ASEAN groups to Guilin or Xishuangbanna (6 days), and cruise groups via Shanghai (15 days).

other: Must be a group of two or more organized by a licensed travel agency.
Each route has its own ports and allowed areas.
Individuals from countries with a unilateral policy should use that instead.

name: Port Visa
summary: A single-entry visa issued at a designated port for urgent reasons like emergencies or urgent business. Stay is up to 30 days.

other: Needs documents showing the competent Chinese authority approved the application.

sources.label: NIA: Port Visa and Regional Visa-Free Entry Policies

name: L Visa (Tourist)
summary: Regular tourist visa for travelers who need a visa and are not covered by a visa-free policy. Apply online through the MFA visa system and then at an embassy or visa center.

other: Official category details could not be opened. Check the MFA visa portal at consular.mfa.gov.cn/VISA/ before relying on this.

name: F Visa (Exchange and Visit)
summary: Visa for exchanges, visits and non-commercial activities, usually with an invitation from a Chinese unit. Not for paid work.

name: Z Visa (Work)
summary: Entry visa for foreigners who will work in China. You need a work permit notification first, then convert to a residence permit after arrival.

other: Needs a Chinese employer and work permit approval.
Official category details could not be opened. Check the MFA visa portal at consular.mfa.gov.cn/VISA/ before relying on this.

steps: Employer applies for the work permit notification.
Apply for the Z visa abroad.
Enter China and apply for a work residence permit within 30 days.

name: Foreigner's Work Permit (Class A, B, C)

citizenship.note: China does not recognize dual nationality. Naturalizing means giving up your old nationality.
